title: "Mixed numeric and categorical features"
---

::: {.callout-note}
## Implementation ongoing

This page describes work in progress.
(`gflownet/envs/tree/mixed_node.py`)
:::

## Goal

Right now a `Tree` is either fully numeric or fully categorical
(`is_categorical` applies to the whole tree). The goal is a single node
type that can split on **both** kinds of features in the same tree:

- numeric feature: `x[f] <= t`
- categorical feature: `x[f] in L`

## `DecisionTreeNodeMixed`

The node is a `Stack` of three stages:

0. **feature**: a `Choice` over all features;
1. **threshold**: a `Choice` over `n_thresholds` discrete thresholds, as in
   `DecisionTreeNodeDiscreteChoice`. Used only when the chosen feature is
   numeric;
2. **category**: a `SubsetSequential` that builds the left set `L`, as in
   `DecisionTreeNodeCategoricalSequential`. Used only when the chosen
   feature is categorical.

A node uses only one of stages 1 and 2. The other one stays at its source state:

| Feature type | Path through the stages | Ends with |
|---|---|---|
| numeric | 0 → 1 → done | the threshold EOS |
| categorical | 0 → 2 → done (stage 1 skipped) | the subset STOP |
